name: privacy_loud_log_carries_no_secret
reason: the daemon quarantined a credential-bearing object and Louded about it; logs/LOUD.log was written, was swept by name, and carries no literal and no >8-byte fragment of any of the 11 planted credentials. The Loud names a 12-character hash prefix and a reason, never a span of the content.
detail: expand envelope unavailable; logs/ held [logs/LOUD.log logs/qompack-20260922.log]
